title: Heart Review Bot and Better Run Logs
description:
A bot that reviews your Heart fights move by move, plus a run logger that records every decision you make.

[h2]Heart reviews on spirepilot.com[/h2]
Share your runs and the bot replays your Ironclad A20 Heart fights turn by turn. For each turn it shows the line you played, the line it would play, and its next-best options. It plays each line out to the end of the fight many times, then shows your win chance and the HP you would lose. Open any line to see every playout turn by turn. On the Heart, the bot already beats top players on the same boards.

Sharing is optional. The mod asks once on the main menu and sends nothing unless you say yes. Your stats and Heart reviews appear on spirepilot.com under your Steam name.

Change your mind any time in Mods > Better Run Logs > Config:
[list]
[*]Turn sharing on or off.
[*]Open your stats page.
[*]Remove your runs from the site.
[/list]

[h2]Better Run Logs[/h2]
The game's own run history throws away your combat decisions. This mod keeps them. It records everything about a run in one file:
[list]
[*]every card played, with its target
[*]every potion used or discarded
[*]every event option offered and chosen
[*]card rewards and Discovery picks
[*]shop stock, prices, purchases and removals
[*]campfire choices and reward pickups
[*]relic counters and keys
[*]your map path, including Winged Boots flights
[*]the state of every RNG stream
[/list]
Logs are saved in your game folder under better-run-logs/<CHARACTER>/<timestamp>.jsonl.gz. Each log also contains the game's own .run data, so it is the only file you need. A run that reaches the Heart is 200 to 300 kB compressed.

Does not change gameplay. Works with any character, including modded ones. Requires BaseMod.

Reviews: https://spirepilot.com
Source, log format and full docs: https://github.com/cmyers009/better-run-logs
changeNote: 0.3.0: optional run sharing with spirepilot.com. Asked once on the main menu; nothing is sent unless you say yes. Opt out, view your stats or remove your runs from the site in Mods > Better Run Logs > Config. Finished logs are now written atomically.
